hypotheses.claim: Frozen native base bank plus independently supervised H2GCN side members improve accuracy and common-opponent repair more than feature-only side members.
controls: native SINGLE alias and native independent4
independent native8 to control total member count; disclose different cost
standalone H2GCN1 alias and side-only bank
admitted modern heterophily baselines including strong MLP/LINKX where applicable
diagnostics: correct-side-member emergence on base common error cohort
falsifiers: no accuracy gain over frozen native bank
only probability loss gain with accuracy loss
no added common-error repair beyond feature-only control
gain fully explained by H2 side-only bank
hypotheses.loss: Independent own CE; no new error-weighted loss
